AnalysisPhase.description:
`from` / `to`: the spell on the match clock (45 is the second half's kick-off); `window`: the
elapsed minutes it covers (from <= minute < to).
AnalysisPhase.title: AnalysisPhase

AnalysisRolling.description: `from` / `to`: elapsed minutes (from <= minute < to); `period`: the period the window starts in.
AnalysisRolling.title: AnalysisRolling

AnalysisSub.description: One substitution: `minute` is the elapsed minute, `clock` the match clock's (54 for 54').
AnalysisSub.title: AnalysisSub

ArmStats.description: Why an arm came out as it did: its final scores and each team's numbers after the replay start.
ArmStats.title: ArmStats

AttributeSummary.description: Six headline ratings, weighted from the detailed ones (an approximation of game cards).
AttributeSummary.title: AttributeSummary

AveragePositionsReport.description: GET /api/matches/{id}/positions: everyone who played, from the tracking frames.
AveragePositionsReport.title: AveragePositionsReport

ContextEffect.description: One modifier the simulator applied because of the context. Small by design (|delta| <= 0.15).
ContextEffect.title: ContextEffect

HeadToHead.description: Record between the two clubs, counted from this match's home side.
HeadToHead.title: HeadToHead

HeatmapReport.description: GET /api/matches/{id}/heatmaps: where each team and player spent their time.
HeatmapReport.title: HeatmapReport

area.description: Penalty or six-yard box `location` falls in, if any, from the acting team's view.

clock_label.description: What a broadcast would show: 63', 45+2', 105+1', or PEN in the shootout.

lane.description: Vertical lane of `location` (wings, half-spaces, centre), from the acting team's view.

minute.description: Elapsed match minute (0-based, stoppage and extra time included): t // 60.

third.description: Pitch third of `location`, from the acting team's point of view.

OffFieldEvent.description: A fictional news item about a player or coach before the match.
OffFieldEvent.title: OffFieldEvent

OutcomeDist.description: Result after 90 minutes, plus who goes through when extra time and penalties apply.
OutcomeDist.title: OutcomeDist

OverlayCard.description: A confirmed pivot as a lower-third card, timed on the match clock (FR-26).
OverlayCard.title: OverlayCard

OverlayFrame.description: What the overlay shows at one moment of the match clock: the score bug and at most one card.
OverlayFrame.title: OverlayFrame

OverlayItem.description: One graphic that a broadcast renderer can place on top of the live feed.
OverlayItem.title: OverlayItem

OverlayTimeline.description: Every card of a match in clock order, never overlapping, for recordings and the preview page.
OverlayTimeline.title: OverlayTimeline

PassNetworkReport.description: GET /api/matches/{id}/pass-network: each side's starting eleven and who passed to whom.
PassNetworkReport.title: PassNetworkReport

PeriodInfo.description: When each period started and ended on the elapsed clock, so any `t` can be labelled.
PeriodInfo.title: PeriodInfo

Personality.description: Hidden traits. They never show on screen but shape how a player reacts to context.
Personality.title: Personality

PivotCandidate.description: CUSUM alarm, queued for the Judge. Message id is "{match_id}:{minute}".
PivotCandidate.title: PivotCandidate

PlantSpec.description: Force an event at a given minute. Used by the eval seeds and the demo preset.
PlantSpec.title: PlantSpec

PlayerAttributes.description: 34 visible ratings in seven groups. The simulator reads these directly.
PlayerAttributes.title: PlayerAttributes

PlayerMatchStats.description: One player's line for this match, updated live, like the ratings in score apps.
PlayerMatchStats.title: PlayerMatchStats

PlayerPivotLink.description: A turning point a player took part in.
PlayerPivotLink.title: PlayerPivotLink

PlayerReport.description: What the page can show about one player, up to a point in the match (focus-player card).
PlayerReport.title: PlayerReport

PlayerStatsReport.description: GET /api/matches/{id}/players/stats: every player of both squads, or the one asked for.
PlayerStatsReport.title: PlayerStatsReport

PrematchGame.description: One recent league game, seen from the team: `ft` and `ht` are [this team, opponent].
PrematchGame.title: PrematchGame

PrematchMeeting.description: `ft` and `ht` are [home, away] of that meeting.
PrematchMeeting.title: PrematchMeeting

PrematchText.description:
`texts`: each English sentence of the pre-match tab that has a translation, and that translation.
A sentence missing here is shown in English. `untranslated` lists those sentences.
PrematchText.title: PrematchText

Relationship.description: A tie between two people that can matter on match day (chemistry, motivation, needle).
Relationship.title: Relationship

ShotMap.description: GET /api/matches/{id}/shots: every shot so far (the shootout left out).
ShotMap.title: ShotMap

ShotMapShot.description: One shot: where from and where to, from the shooter's side, the goal they attack at x = 105.
ShotMapShot.title: ShotMapShot

Spread.description: One number over all runs of an arm: its mean, standard deviation and 10th/90th percentiles.
Spread.title: Spread

StatMetricInfo.description: How the page labels one stat, so it hard-codes nothing (the D02 vocabulary, MET-001 to MET-023).
StatMetricInfo.title: StatMetricInfo

TeamRunStats.description: What one team did from the replay start to the end, over all runs of an arm (Bx10).
TeamRunStats.title: TeamRunStats

TeamStatsReport.description: GET /api/matches/{id}/stats: the 23 team stats per part of the match, with their labels.
TeamStatsReport.title: TeamStatsReport

TeamStatsScope.description: Both teams' stats for one part of the match. A stat with no answer is null, never 0.
TeamStatsScope.title: TeamStatsScope
